entities.name: Vlasta Parkanová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vlasta Parkanová, née Trnovcová is a Czech politician who served from January 2007 to May 2009 as the minister of Defence and shortly as minister of Justice between 1997 and 1998. She was member of the Chamber of Deputies (MP) from 1997 to 2013.

entities.summary: Vlasta Parkanová, née Trnovcová is a Czech politician who served from January 2007 to May 2009 as the minister of Defence and shortly as minister of Justice between 1997 and 1998. She was member of the Chamber of Deputies (MP) from 1997 to 2013.
